bullets.text: Tiruvallur residents blocked roads at night over power cuts, and the office should monitor the electricity situation.
A sudden sinkhole formed near Nehru Nagar in Velachery causing traffic disruption, and the office must watch traffic updates.
Parents and students in Mambakkam Chatram fear venomous creatures due to overgrown school premises, and the office should request immediate clearing.
A cyclonic storm is likely to form over the Bay of Bengal bringing rain, and the district team must stay alert.
Damaged slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB put Tiruvallur residents at risk, and the office should urge the highways department to act.
Cisco executive Jeetu Patel supports giving Gen Z unlimited AI access to accelerate software development, and our portfolio team should review this approach.
OpenAI chief Sam Altman questioned PC RAM use amid global DRAM pressure, and the office should monitor memory supply chain trends.
